tei:titleStmt.tei:title: בְּרָכוֹת שֶׁנִּתָּנִי
Berakhot Shenitani: Dass ich erlebe — haiku adaptions of some of the morning blessings by Rivka Jaussi

tei:div.tei:head: Berakhot Shenitani: Dass ich erlebe — haiku adaptions of some of the morning blessings by Rivka Jaussi

tei:lg.tei:l: The series of three-line poems is based on the haiku form (poems with 5-7-5 syllables), which has a meditative component in Zen. This poetic form is ideal for morning blessings with their identical beginnings. In my version, both the beginning and the end always have the same wording.

What does the content of each individual Hebrew blessing stand for in terms of morning activities? There are various suggestions for this. I was particularly inspired by Marcia Prager’s “The Path of Blessing.”
